title: Tracecat 1.0.0-beta.52-rc.21
body_markdown:
## Tables


- fix(tables): Preserve NULL for TEXT columns in to_sql_clause ([#3365](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3365) )


## Engine


- feat(logging): Trace API workflows through Temporal ([#3274](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3274) )
- fix(engine): Preserve workflow failure through handler errors ([#3373](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3373) )


## Infrastructure


- ci: Enforce commit conventions and rebuild release-note sections ([#3361](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3361) )
- ci: Keep each pull request in one release-notes section ([#3369](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3369) )
- ci: Reject workflows as a scope, it names two different things ([#3370](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3370) )
- ci: Stop the dedupe step untagging the draft release ([#3371](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3371) )
- ci: Stop enterprise deciding the release-notes section ([#3372](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3372) )
- ci: Reject GitHub's revert titles in favour of revert(scope) ([#3375](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3375) )


**Full changelog** :[1.0.0-beta.52-rc.20...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.21](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.0.0-beta.52-rc.20...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.21)
